summary: The only new items I could find for Nov 4-5 are the 10-Q filing (listed on EDGAR, text not read because sec.gov blocks automated fetches, so unverified for content) and a D.A. Davidson target cut from 330 to 235 seen only on a relay site (rallies.ai); neither is a verified thesis trigger and a target change is already inside the scenarios.
